subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should this PR's first-class Tailscale/MagicDNS onboarding path be preserved and rebased onto the current post-refresh iOS onboarding flow, or should maintainers keep the already-merged simpler onboarding refresh and ask for smaller follow-ups?
rationale: The branch adds a new first-run connection decision tree that overlaps a merged onboarding refresh and changes the user-facing remote setup path; choosing whether to keep that UX is maintainer product/security-boundary judgment rather than a mechanical repair verdict.

options.title: Rebase and narrow
options.body: Preserve the secure Tailscale/MagicDNS path and password-missing auth copy, but rebase it onto current main and remove obsolete onboarding/registry conflicts.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Keep the merged onboarding refresh as the canonical UX and request a smaller follow-up only for any missing Tailscale or auth-copy deltas.

options.title: Defer remote onboarding
options.body: Pause this PR until the open discovered-gateway/Tailscale diagnostics issue has a maintainer-approved security and UX direction.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow
recommendation.body: Preserve the secure Tailscale/MagicDNS path and password-missing auth copy, but rebase it onto current main and remove obsolete onboarding/registry conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on the adjacent gateway setup/security boundary and is best placed to decide whether this Tailscale onboarding policy should be preserved.
